features.name: has_three_plus_counter_comments
features.definition: Does the discussion contain at least three distinct counter-argument comments?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list. If missing or malformed (not a list), return null. Keep entries that are strings with non-whitespace content; count distinct entries by exact string equality after strip(). Return 1 if the distinct count >= 3, else 0 (an empty list gives 0).

h0: has_three_plus_counter_comments has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view.
h1: Discussions with has_three_plus_counter_comments = 1 have a higher probability of OP view change than those with fewer than three.
note: Distinct is operationalized as unique comment strings in OC_comments; distinct commenters cannot be determined. OC_comments only holds the available counter-comments, which may be a subset of the full thread, and may include later replies or text revealing the outcome (raw count, not filtered). Association only, tested via OLS (linear probability).
